about_short_description.short_description: Curebase is the modern eClinical platform for faster study builds, better engagement, and seamless data capture.

product.name: ePRO (Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes)
product.description: A platform to design, deploy, and collect patient-reported outcomes electronically via validated forms accessible on multiple devices.

product.name: eConsent
product.description: A digital consent management system that delivers interactive, multimedia-informed consent experiences compliant with global regulations.

product.name: Electronic Data Capture (EDC)
product.description: An integrated electronic data capture system for clinical trial data entry, review, and management across devices and study sites.

product.name: Patient Engagement Platform
product.description: A set of integrated tools for managing patient communication, scheduling, reminders, payments, and engagement analytics within clinical trials.

product.name: Curebase Campaigns
product.description: A module for running participant recruitment campaigns directly within the Curebase platform using multi-channel outreach and real-time tracking.

product.name: Validated ePRO Forms Library
product.description: A collection of pre-built, compliance-ready electronic patient questionnaires and standardized data collection forms for clinical trials.
